name: Kinara first-party datasheets and domain inaccessible (HTTP 404)
symptom: HTTP 404 Not Found returned when fetching kinara.ai, www.kinara.ai, and specific product paths (ara-1, ara-2).
root_cause: Following corporate acquisition/restructuring, Kinara primary domain (kinara.ai) is offline or misconfigured, leaving zero accessible first-party specification tables or datasheets for Ara-1 or Ara-2 on the open web. Secondary news articles report 6 TOPS for Ara-1 and 40 TOPS for Ara-2, but per knowledge base provenance rules, unverified secondary aggregator numbers cannot substitute for primary datasheets.
workaround: Refuse to guess Ara-1 or Ara-2 numbers from secondary press. Wait for the acquiring entity to publish official datasheets or product documentation before authoring accelerator records.
notes: Probed on 2026-10-11. Probes across http/https and multiple endpoints on kinara.ai returned HTTP 404.
